name: Grand Synagogue of Tunis
scope: The standing 1937 Grand Synagogue of Tunis, facing Avenue de la Liberté. Includes the central hall exterior, stepped dome, stepped main façade and two entry pavilions.

review.notes: Reviewed the Qualla inventory first and checked the exact byte-identical PD-self photograph. Its release does not identify rights in the separate architecture. The heritage institute asks for further reuse permission. Written facts from architectural studies and the named native plot were used.
